exposure: SARS-CoV-2 infection during Controlled Ovarian Stimulation (COS)
cohort: The study included 300 infertile couples undergoing frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET), divided into those with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection during controlled ovarian stimulation (n=126) and non-infected controls (n=174).
finding: No significant differences were observed in pregnancy and obstetric outcomes between patients with embryos generated from SARS-CoV-2 infection during COS and unexposed controls.
mod_finding: No significant intergroup differences were observed in cesarean section rates.
